description: Locale-correct display of a decimal, currency amount or percentage using CLDR rules: grouping (1,234,567 / 12,34,567 / 1.234.567 / 1 234 567), decimal mark, currency symbol placement, Arabic-Indic digits for ar_* locales. Example: number 1234567.891, locale 'en_IN', style 'currency', currency 'INR'. Response: result plus data_confidence, estimated_items[], sources[], data_version, warnings[]; deterministic (no AI inside), nothing logged.

decimals.description: Force a number of decimal places; default = locale/currency rule.
decimals.title: Decimals

numbering.description: Digit system: locale default (ar_EG → Arabic-Indic, ar_AE → Western), or force latn / arab.
numbering.title: Numbering
